title: Customer Service Advisor

The Role As a Customer Services Advisor, you ll play a key role in maintaining strong customer relationships and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of commercial operations. Key responsibilities include: - Handling incoming customer calls and emails professionally and efficiently. - Managing job bookings, responding to customer queries and completing general administration. - Maintaining accurate and up-to-date customer records and databases. - Supporting invoicing activities and ensuring deadlines are met. - Building and maintaining strong relationships with existing customers. - Developing new customer relationships and re-engaging with lapsed clients. - Working closely with internal teams, including Sales, Transport and Finance, to ensure a seamless customer experience. You ll ideally have: - Previous experience in customer service, administration or a similar fast-paced role. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. - Strong organisational skills and exceptional attention to detail. - An analytical mindset and a proactive, can-do attitude. - The ability to work well under pressure and manage competing priorities. - Confidence using Microsoft Office at an advanced level. - A collaborative approach and the ability to build positive relationships with What s on Offer? - The opportunity to join an established and growing business. - A supportive, team-oriented working environment. - Training and ongoing professional development opportunities. - Access to health and wellbeing support. - On-site facilities, including secure parking and gym facilities at the head office.

title: Customer Service Agent

Exceptional level of attention to detail. Proficient typing skills (touch typing preferred). Excellent customer service skills including; conversation control, written etiquette, handling multiple conversations at once, queue management and the ability to deliver timely and accurate information. Demonstrated ability to quickly identify issues and clearly state solutions and/or recommendations. Ability to engage with all parties to discuss issues in a positive and constructive manner.
